shots.desc: Morning after — city blames the six
shots.prompt: Morning after a city-wide disaster, news vans and police barricades on wet streets, a giant public screen showing six blurred suspect photos with the word TERRORISTS in bold, crowds in masks watching, military drones hovering over a modern Indian megacity, overcast grey light, photorealistic, cinematic wide shot, film grain

shots.desc: Aarav hides in the old metro
shots.prompt: Underground abandoned metro station at night, a 24-year-old Indian man in a grey torn hoodie sitting alone on an old bench under a flickering tube light, blue police drone lights sweeping through a distant tunnel, shadows of wanted posters on the wall, photorealistic, slow dolly-in, cold blue rim light, film grain

A 13-year-old street boy with big taped glasses and an oversized yellow rain jacket appears from the dark tunnel and screams at a drone, a visible shockwave of sound shattering every fluorescent tube in the abandoned metro station, sparks and glass hanging in the air, photorealistic, fast camera pull-back, dramatic rim light

A 24-year-old Indian man in a grey hoodie reaches his hand out and dozens of shards of glass and iron freeze in mid-air around him, blue rings of light crawling up his forearm, his terrified wide eyes reflecting the floating debris, underground station, photorealistic, slow orbit camera, volumetric light

Night shelter interior full of sleeping children, police drones crashing through the windows, a 58-year-old Indian nun with silver hair in a white saree stands protectively in front of the children, a blade of golden-white light extends from her saree border and slices a falling drone clean in half, sparks and smoke, photorealistic, dramatic backlight, film grain

Close-up of the 58-year-old nun's hand closing into a fist, the blade of light folding back into the blue border of her saree like a switchblade, her calm hawk-like eyes, children hiding behind her, smoke in the air, photorealistic, shallow depth of field

Dark laboratory, a 36-year-old Japanese woman with red glasses and a white lab coat stares at a holographic waveform pulsing from a small black star-shard fragment on a steel table, the waveform looks like a heartbeat, her face lit blue, data screens behind her showing a map of the city with six glowing points, photorealistic, slow push-in

shots.desc: The call comes from the tower
shots.prompt: Holographic city map zooming into a single glass skyscraper tower, six blue points of light scattered across the city and all of them sending thin signal lines toward the tower, a woman's hand reaching toward the hologram, photorealistic, dark lab, blue light

The 36-year-old Japanese scientist closes her eyes and takes the star-shard fragment in her bare hand, a thin blue line of light running from the shard to her wrist like a vein, her small wrong smile returns, cold laboratory light, photorealistic, static close-up

Basement police evidence room at night, a 31-year-old woman detective with short dark hair and a brown leather jacket opens a steel locker labeled CLASSIFIED, inside a single grey dead star-shard sits on black velvet, cold fluorescent light, photorealistic, slow dolly-in, noir shadows

Extreme macro close-up of a grey dead star-shard on black velvet, a thin blue vein of light crawling across its cracked surface like a memory trying to wake, the detective's grey-green eye reflected in the shard, photorealistic, macro lens, cold blue glow

shots.desc: The memory that is not hers
shots.prompt: Vision flash: a night sky cracking open 40 years ago over the same city, a small boy with a red mark under his left eye watching blue fire fall, the vision dissolves back to the detective's face, tears she did not expect, double exposure effect, photorealistic, dreamlike color grade

Elegant office of a police commissioner, a 62-year-old wealthy man in a black three-piece suit shakes hands with a nervous uniformed officer, a small red mark under his left eye, his black leather gloves, a silver pocket watch chain visible, floor-to-ceiling windows with the city behind, photorealistic, slow push-in, warm polite menace

Extreme close-up of an old man's black leather glove as he adjusts his cuff, for one second the leather turns translucent and a red glowing star-shard is visible stitched into the glove's lining, then it is leather again, photorealistic, macro lens, dramatic shadow

Underground hideout, a 24-year-old man in a grey hoodie and a 13-year-old boy in a yellow rain jacket face off against a 31-year-old woman detective in a brown leather jacket holding up her badge, tension, a nun in a white saree watching from the shadows, single hanging bulb, photorealistic, over-the-shoulder handheld camera

A mysterious androgynous young person with long black hair and one white streak steps out of a wall shadow into the underground hideout, grey eyes with a faint gold ring, everyone freezes, double-echo voice implied by the stillness, photorealistic, slow push-in, cold rim light

Chase through narrow old-city alleyways at night, four young people and a detective running toward the camera, police drones sweeping searchlights behind them, washing lines and neon signs overhead, wet cobblestones, photorealistic, fast handheld camera, blue and orange contrast lighting, film grain

The 36-year-old Japanese scientist at her lab window watches the drones chase the group through the city, she presses her palm to the glass and a thin blue line of light runs from her wrist into the building's frame, she whispers, cold lab light against warm city glow, photorealistic, static shot

The words EVERFALL in clean white thin sans-serif letters above WANTED SPARKS in smaller letters, centered over a night city skyline with police drones sweeping searchlights, cinematic, minimal, film grain, no other text
